evidence_tier.tier_1_wnet: tests/mapmatching_wnet_oracle.rs: 31 executed-C++ instances of WNetAligner<2> and WNetMatcher::match (scale factor and total cost bit for bit, every flow in order, the greedy consensus in order; integer lattices and a full grid with massive ties); tests/mapmatching_wnet_grouping_oracle.rs: 13 FeatureGroupingAlgorithmWNet tool-path cases, 4 class-test sections and the defaults tree (handles exact, RT/m/z 1e-12 relative, float values one f32 unit); tests/mapmatching_wnet_topp.rs: TOPP_FeatureLinkerWNet_1 against its retained output (handles exact).
